Maya P: quick thought //- we need a deterministic control-plane -> proxy handshake for evacuations. propose a quiesce token flow (push or poll).
Noah V: sketch? push /v2/evacuate/{region} with token + TTL, proxies ack and move through PREPARE -> SOFT_DRAIN -> FORCE_REROUTE.
Ivy S: must respect tenant residency. control-plane includes tenant_allowlist with fallback_policy per-tenant. proxies report blocked tenants.
Ravi K: ops: attach lease and auto-rollback if not confirmed in TTL. add /force endpoint for operator override with audit-headers.
eng-prod: runbook: post token, wait for >=90% acks or timeout, monitor routing-shift metrics, revert on failures. add canary: staging -> 1 region -> 10% proxies.
Noah V: API suggestion: body = {token, ttl_s, stages:[{name,duration_s}], tenant_constraints_url}. proxy resp = {proxy_id,stage_status,blocked_count}. keep small.
Ivy S: security: HMAC-signed tokens per-region so cross-region misuse is hard. log audit events to immutable store. privacy: only tenant hashes retained briefly.
Maya P: routing during SOFT_DRAIN: stop accepting new primaries for eligible tenants, finish inflight, then either redirect clients (302 header) or proxy-forward. transparent mode should rewrite routing headers and preserve trace ids.
Ravi K: edge cases: overlapping evacuations -> precedence by token timestamp; delayed acks -> risk of duplicate paths, rely on idempotency keys and safe-cutover windows.
eng-prod: telemetry: emit evacuate_metrics{region,stage,ack_rate,blocked_tenants,pct_inflight}. alert: avg(ack_rate) < 0.8 for 2m => page.
Noah V: network mode: support push via websocket mTLS and poll fallback (/status) every 2s with jitter. polling simpler for flaky proxies.
Ivy S: privacy retention table for RFC: token UUID 7d, tenant_hash 24h, stage_logs 72h, no request bodies.
Maya P: action items: I'll draft RFC with API shapes + failure modes; Ivy add privacy/key rotation checklist; Ravi implement operator APIs + idempotency guidance; eng-prod schedule canary.
